definitions.explanation: A Japanese dish made by steaming a seasoned egg mixture with dashi in a cup-like bowl. It contains ingredients such as chicken, shrimp, mushrooms, and ginkgo nuts. Served warm as a side dish in Japanese cuisine.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A classic Japanese dish often served at ⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧ (sushi restaurants) and in {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり} (traditional multi-course meals). The name literally means "tea bowl steamed" — ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧ (tea bowl/cup) + ⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸し：14266_mushi⟧ (steaming). Common ingredients include ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧ (chicken), ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧ (shrimp), {椎茸|しいたけ} (shiitake mushrooms), ⟦{銀杏|ぎんなん}→銀杏：28490_ginnan⟧ (ginkgo nuts), and ⟦{三|み}つ{葉|ば}→三つ葉：11242_mitsuba⟧ (mitsuba herb).
